title: Cargo Role Validation Rules
description: Semantic validation rules for cargo identities that may hold more than one economic role.

rules.condition: cargo.classes exists and contains at least one role
every value in cargo.classes is one of primary, product, operational_supply, human_flow, financial, optional
optional must not be the only class when the cargo participates in a production, consumption, supply, human-flow, or financial relationship
relationships must be compatible with at least one declared cargo class
multiple classes describe one stable cargo identity; they must not cause duplicate cargo IDs or duplicate transport slots

roleSemantics.primary: Normally produced by extraction or harvesting activity.
roleSemantics.product: Produced by processing, refinement, or manufacturing activity.
roleSemantics.operational_supply: Delivered as an operational service input and normally affects productivity, capacity, reliability, or efficiency rather than acting as a universal hard prerequisite.
roleSemantics.human_flow: Represents passengers, personnel, mail, or another explicitly defined human/economic flow.
roleSemantics.financial: Represents an optional physical financial flow; it does not replace systemic money.
roleSemantics.optional: Availability or module designation; not a substitute for a semantic economic role.
